structure.unit: Highways and Other Surface Transportation Systems
Commonwealth Transportation Board; Powers and Duties

law.catch_line: Sections not applicable to certain engines and tractors
law.text: The provisions of §§ 33.2-210 and 33.2-211 shall not apply to traction engines and tractors weighing not less than five tons when drawing threshing machines, hay balers, or other farm machinery for local farm use.
